notes:
ROUTE: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab (tabId 1961714863). robots.txt was fetched same-origin from the loaded FR page first: 4054 bytes, 92 Disallow lines under User-agent: *, none of them covering /fr/ or /cat/, no blanket Disallow: /, and no mention anywhere of anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot. No curl / requests / WebFetch / proxy was used at any point; every fetch() ran inside the loaded ikea.com/fr/fr page context. No 403, CAPTCHA, DataDome or rate-limit was seen at any stage.

TREE SOURCE: script[type=text/hydrate] -> data.config.catalogSlim on https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/cat/meubles-fu001/ (child key is 'subs', as f107 established on the DE store, NOT 'subCategories'). The FR payload has 21 top-level departments. Furniture was assembled from the FR store's real departments: fu002 Tables & chaises, 700640 Canapes & fauteuils, bm001 Lits & matelas, st001 Rangements, fu004 Bureaux & chaises de bureau, ba001 Salle de bain, od001 Amenagement exterieur (od003 Mobilier de jardin) and bc001 Bebe & enfant - 548 nodes in those eight. To satisfy the 'nav under-reports' trap the whole catalogSlim (all 21 departments) was keyword-swept in French for canape/fauteuil/chaise/tabouret/table/bureau/lit/armoire/commode/banc/buffet/etagere/bibliotheque/meuble/coiffeuse/penderie/desserte/vitrine/pouf; every hit outside the eight furniture departments was a kitchen fixture (ka001 METOD/ENHET/KNOXHULT fitted-kitchen cabinets), tableware (kt001 'linge de table', 'couverts de table'), lighting (li001 'lampes de bureau'), decor (de001 'horloges murales et de table') or a desk accessory (st007 'organisateurs de bureau') - i.e. no furniture node lives outside the eight departments.

QTY METHOD AND THE HEADER CONVENTION - THIS MATCHES f107 (IKEA DE) DELIBERATELY: for every leaf the figure in qty is productListPage.productCount from sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/fr/fr/product-list-page?category=<id>, fetched from the loaded page. IKEA's rendered listing header is INFLATED BY EXACTLY +1 whenever plannerCount>0, because client-side hydration injects a non-product planner tile. This was MEASURED on FR, not assumed, on four category pages loaded in the tab and read from the live DOM: tables-basses-10716 productCount 44 / plannerCount 1 / header '45 elements'; tables-de-salle-a-manger-21825 productCount 86 / plannerCount 2 / header '87 elements' (so it is +1 even at plannerCount=2 - the header is NOT productCount+plannerCount); rangements-cubiques-55012 productCount 78 / plannerCount 0 / header '78 elements'; armoires-integrees-43632 productCount 403 / plannerCount 0 / header '403 elements'. The server-delivered HTML carries the un-inflated number (a raw same-origin fetch of tables-basses-10716 returns '44 elements' inside p.plp-filter-information__total-count while the hydrated DOM shows '45 elements'), exactly as on the DE store. 82 of the 116 FR leaves have plannerCount>0 and are therefore affected. FOLLOWING f107 EXPLICITLY: qty is the ENUMERATED PRODUCT COUNT and the header figure is stated inside every evidence string, so whichever convention the orchestrator settles on stays recoverable, and IKEA FR is directly comparable with IKEA DE. CACHING CAUTION worth passing on: a raw same-origin fetch of armoires-integrees-43632 returned a STALE CDN-cached SSR snapshot saying '445 elements' / 'Affiche 24 resultats sur 445', while the same page loaded live in the tab showed '403 elements' and the API 403 - so the raw-HTML header is not always current, and the live DOM plus the API agree.

VERIFICATION: (1) full enumeration - /product-list-page/more-products?category=<id>&start=0&end=productCount+30 was run on a 12-leaf sample spanning the whole range (25206=1, 47360=1, 55021=1, 700441=2, 19143=3, 45815=4, 20611=7, 20926=52, 21958=56, 25219=110, 10382=116, fu003=227) and returned exactly productCount tiles with exactly productCount unique itemNoGlobal values in 12/12 cases - unique product IDs, not href counting. (2) boundary test - start=productCount-1 returned exactly 1 item and start=productCount returned 0 items on an 8-leaf sample (20611=7, 20926=52, 21958=56, 25219=110, 10382=116, 20720=134, fu003=227, 43632=403), 8/8 pass, so no total is truncated or padded. The exhaustive 117/117 version of both checks was already run by f107 on the same global platform, so it was sampled rather than repeated here. (3) the API echoed back category.name and category.url for all 116 ids and each matched the node taken from catalogSlim, so no id silently served a parent listing; the h1 of every page actually loaded matched the node requested. (4) 59 distinct qty values across 116 leaves spanning 1-403 - no site-wide constant, no suspiciously round display cap.

INDEPENDENCE FROM IKEA DE (f107): IKEA runs one global platform, so 116 of DE's 117 leaf category IDs also resolve on FR (700424 Conference table with chairs sets does not exist in the FR tree - that is the single missing node). The FR figures are nevertheless the FR market's own: Coffee Tables DE 45 / FR 44, Dining Tables DE 92 / FR 86, Sofas DE 274 / FR 227, Beds DE 226 / FR 232, Fitted Wardrobes DE 389 / FR 403, Dining Chairs DE 112 / FR 110. The FR department layout also differs from DE's: FR groups tables under 700675 Tables with a 10705 'Tables basses et tables d'appoint' sub-branch, puts the wardrobe leaves under 19053 'Armoires et penderies' rather than a wardrobe hub, files office storage under st001>10385 rather than the office department, and splits garden chairs under 21964 and outdoor tables under 700191, neither of which exists as a node on DE. All names below are translated from the FR store's own wording; nothing was copied from the German labels.

STOPPING RULE: stopped above nodes that only split by seat count, size, material or series - 21825 Tables de salle a manger -> Tables 2/4/6/8/10 personnes, 19145 Ensembles tables et chaises -> max. 2/4/6/10 pers., 25219 Chaises de salle a manger -> chaises de table / rembourrees / personnalisables, fu003 Canapes -> 2 places / 3 places / angle / meridienne / modulables / relax, fu006 Fauteuils -> tissu / cuir / rotin / club / relax, 10663 Convertibles -> 2 places / 3 places / angle / chauffeuses, 20926 Repose-pieds -> tissu / cuir / rotin, bm003 Lits -> lits doubles / simples / avec rangement / matelasses / sommiers tapissiers / lits d'appoint et banquettes. NOTE on bm003: its children also cross-link to 18723 Lits enfant, 19039 Lits mezzanine et lits superposes and 18755 Sommeil bebe, all of which ARE emitted as their own leaves under the children's branch; bm003 is kept as a single leaf exactly as f107 did on DE, so the 232 figure covers the adult bed range including 19037 Lits d'appoint et banquettes (day beds), which is not emitted separately.

EXCLUDED, and why: the whole named-series layer under st001>46052 (PAX, BESTA, PLATSA, EKET, IVAR, ELVARLI, BROR, BOAXEL, JONAXEL, JOSTEIN, TROFAST, OMAR, LASTARE, LADMAKARE, GULDDRAGARE, SMASTAD), the bathroom series under ba001>700450, the desk systems under fu004>20649>47423 (MITTZON, TROTTEN, IDASEN, RELATERA) and 11811 Bureaux modulables - all component listings. Also excluded: mattresses and bed bases (bm002 Matelas and its children, 24826 Surmatelas, 18724 Matelas enfant, 45855 Matelas lits bebe, 24825 Sommiers tapissiers, 24827 Sommiers a lattes); bedding and textiles (tl003, tl004, 20542 Galettes de chaise, 46400 Coussins de chaise d'exterieur, 17893 Coussins d'exterieur, 34204 Tapis d'exterieur); furniture parts, covers and care (10664 Housses and its 19 series children, 25223 Housses pour chaise, 57654 Housses pour repose-pieds, 30572 Plateaux et pieds de table, 34006 Chaises personnalisables, 24822 Pieds de lit, 57280 Housses du cadre de lit, 55997 Combinaison porte coulissante, 11845 Pieds et treteaux, 11844 Plateaux de table, 34205 Housses mobilier de jardin, 42948 Huile et lasure); standalone storage goods (st007 Accessoires de rangement, 10797 Boites de stockage, 19059 Rangements de lit, 20479 Boites et paniers enfant, 20474 Rangements jouets, 16233 Paniers de rangement salle de bain); wall shelving (10398 Etageres murales, 20660 Etageres, 20481 rangements muraux enfant, 20615 Etageres murales de salle de bain - Wall Decor's job); bathroom fixtures and mirrors (20723 Vasques et lavabos, 20724 Robinets, 40690 Douches, 30565 Plans de travail, 10555 Accessoires, 20498 Miroirs a poser, 20499 Miroirs grossissants, 49138 Miroirs avec lumieres - only 20500 Meubles hauts avec miroir is kept, because it is a wall cabinet); lighting (li001, 16283 Eclairage integre dressing, 10736, 18773, 17897 Luminaires d'exterieur); appliances and laundry machines (20826, 20608, 24898 Barbecues, 700543/700544 outdoor kitchens); desk screens and office supplies (700336 Separateurs de bureau, 55397 Accessoires de gaming, 10551 Organisateurs de bureau); and the fitted-kitchen tree (ka001 METOD / ENHET / KNOXHULT and their fronts, worktops and sinks). The two furniture nodes IKEA files inside the kitchen and storage trees - 10471 Dessertes et ilots cuisine and 16200 Rangement cellier - are reached through fu005 and st002 and ARE included.

OVERLAPS: the FR tree lists many nodes under two parents (21825 and 25219 under both 700675/700676 and 700417 Meubles de salle a manger; 22659 Tabourets at fu002 level and under 700417; 10412 Buffets under st003 and 30454; 16246 Consoles under 10705 and 30454; 20656 Tables de chevet under bm001 and st004; fu006 Fauteuils under 700676 and 700640; 20862/20864 under both 700675/700676 and 16244; 19143/19144 under those and 19141; 47386 Bancs d'exterieur under 700319 and 700350; 21966 Chaises de jardin under 21964 and 700351; 700192 under od003 and 700191; 21958 under st001 and od003; 20858 under fu005 and ba001; 18707/18708/24714/24715/45816/20483/45815/18768/18769/45782/19049/19048 under both their type parent and the children's tree). Each such leaf is emitted exactly once, under its most natural parent, so there are no duplicate rows. Grouping rows whose every child is placed elsewhere are therefore not emitted at all: 700417 Meubles de salle a manger, 30454 Buffets et consoles, 19141 Mobilier de restaurants et cafes, bc004 Chaises enfant, 700440 Rangements pour le garage, 18706 Rangements enfant, bc002/bc003, 20490 Miroirs salle de bain and ba003 Buanderie.
